Ares Management announced that its credit funds closed approximately $6.3 billion in U.S. direct lending commitments across 55 transactions in the third quarter of 2026. For the 12 months ended September 30, 2026, the firm completed approximately $43.4 billion across 314 transactions. Notable activity in the third quarter included acting as administrative agent, lead arranger, and bookrunner for a senior secured credit facility backing CVC Capital Partners' acquisition of Chess.com.

Ares Management announced that its Ares Credit funds, collectively referred to as Ares, closed approximately $6.3 billion in U.S. direct lending commitments across 55 transactions during the third quarter of 2026.

For the 12 months ended September 30, 2026, Ares closed approximately $43.4 billion in U.S. direct lending commitments across 314 transactions.

Among the selected transactions closed during the third quarter, Ares served as administrative agent, lead arranger and bookrunner for a senior secured credit facility supporting CVC Capital Partners’ acquisition of Chess.com.

p: Ares Management는 신용 기금이 2026년 3분기에 55건의 거래에서 약 63억 달러의 미국 다이렉트 렌딩 약속을 마감했다고 발표했다. 2026년 9월 30일에 종료된 12개월 동안 회사는 314건의 거래에서 약 434억 달러를 완료했다. 3분기의 주목할만한 활동에는 CVC Capital Partners의 Chess.com 인수를 뒷받침하는 고위 담보 신용 시설의 행정 대리인, 수석 주선자 및 북러너 역할이 포함되었다.
